title: Sego Sidecar Request / Response
x-contract-note: RATIFIED (cross-window technical ratification only). NOT Founder or user acceptance. NOT product-release approval. First recorded revision: revisions were not tracked before 2026-09-12, so each schema starts at revision 1; this marker lets a consumer pin and diff the contract source (contract changes land here, not only in the implementation).
description: The chosen public contract for the governed sidecar path (envelope in via stdin, envelope out via stdout as JSON). Ratified by the consuming side on 2026-09-12 together with the sidecar envelope alignment; supersedes the earlier self-described 'PoC placeholder' wording. The 2026-09-12 rollout hold on `parse_status: "no_diff"` was lifted the same day, once the consuming mapper accepted that value and mapped it to Unverified + Missing coverage (see $defs.parse_status).

parse_status.description: Outcome of review-output parsing. The first three values come from ReviewParseStatus (runtime/src/code_review/report.rs:504-508). 'no_diff' is the sidecar envelope's own signal that the selected scope produced no reviewable diff, so no parsing was attempted. EMITTED as of 2026-09-12, after the consuming mapper began accepting it and mapping it to Unverified + Missing coverage. Read it as 'no work to review': not a checker failure, and emphatically not a pass.

action.description: Action to perform. Currently: 'review'. Will expand in C (verify, export, etc.).

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project workspace root.

scope.description: Review scope, e.g. 'staged', 'workspace', 'src/auth'. Null defaults to 'staged'.

options.description: Optional review options. Unknown keys are rejected rather than accepted as no-ops: the implementation refuses any option it does not read. The previously documented include_safety_lock was never implemented and has been removed.

provider.description: Requested provider for the governed plugin path. When supplied, 'model' is required and its provider family must match; when omitted, the family is derived from the model name. A name outside this enum fails with error code unknown_provider; an undeterminable model family fails with unknown_model instead of falling back to environment-variable priority; a contradicting pair fails with provider_model_conflict.

context.description: Optional request context. diff_hash is verified by the implementation; invocation_id is carried through opaquely for execution binding. The previously documented user_intent was never read by any code path and has been removed; unknown keys are rejected.

invocation_id.description: Caller-minted persistent invocation identity (for example an EgoPulse verification/checker execution id). Sego treats it as opaque: it does not parse or interpret it, and never derives execution idempotency from it. Echoed back in the response and persisted on the artifact.

success_response.description: Engine -> sidecar success response via stdout.

review_id.description: Review artifact identifier. Null when the selected scope contained no reviewable diff, in which case nothing was persisted.

diff_hash.description: Hash of the reviewed diff. Null when there was no reviewable diff.

artifact_path.description: Path to the persisted review artifact JSON. Null when there was no reviewable diff.

resolved_provider.description: Provider Sego resolved for this invocation, derived deterministically from the model name by the same function the model client uses. This is Sego's routing decision, NOT a provider-side attestation, and it does not prove which model the provider executed. Null when routing was not reached (error envelopes and the no-diff shortcut).

resolved_model.description: Model Sego sent the request for. Same caveat as resolved_provider: it records the route taken, not what the remote provider actually executed.

invocation_id.description: Caller-minted invocation identity, echoed verbatim from context.invocation_id. Null when the caller supplied none. This is the binding an execution can use to reach the artifact it produced; review_id is Sego's own artifact identity and is NOT an invocation id.

resolved_endpoint.description: Endpoint Sego resolved for this invocation, taken from the same base-URL accessor the model client uses. Null when that provider has no accessor: the value is omitted rather than guessed, and identity_evidence_gap names the gap.

identity_evidence.description: Strength of the identity evidence above. Currently the single value 'self_reported_resolution': Sego resolved the route itself and confirmed it against the wire, which is NOT a provider-side attestation. A future 'provider_attested' value would be a contract extension, deliberately not declared here while Sego cannot produce it.

identity_evidence_gap.description: A named dimension Sego cannot observe, so a consumer never infers an evidence gap from a missing field. Currently expected to be null: every routable provider has a base-URL accessor. A non-null value names a provider without one. The field is kept deliberately — the capability to express a gap matters more than the absence of one today, and removing it would be another contract-visible change.

findings.description: Flat findings list. This is the shape the current implementation emits.

report.description: Reserved nested form (findings + parse_status). The current implementation emits the flat top-level 'findings' + 'parse_status' instead; consumers must not require this object.

error.description: Always null in a success envelope; present so both envelopes share one flat shape.

invest_judgment.description: Investment judgment verdict (future, not required in B). Refined in C.

error_response.description: Engine -> sidecar error response via stdout.

review_id.description: Always null in an error envelope.

diff_hash.description: Always null in an error envelope.

artifact_path.description: Always null in an error envelope.

findings.description: Always null in an error envelope.

parse_status.description: Always null in an error envelope.

resolved_provider.description: Always null in an error envelope.

resolved_model.description: Always null in an error envelope.

invocation_id.description: Always null in an error envelope.

resolved_endpoint.description: Always null in an error envelope.

identity_evidence.description: Always null in an error envelope.

identity_evidence_gap.description: Always null in an error envelope.
